enum AcmeLabsFont {
    static let headingFamily = "Space Grotesk"
    static let bodyFamily = "Inter"

    /// Font files must be added to the app target and listed under UIAppFonts in Info.plist.
    static func heading(_ size: CGFloat) -> Font { .custom(headingFamily, size: size).weight(.semibold) }
    static func body(_ size: CGFloat) -> Font { .custom(bodyFamily, size: size) }
